mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemDetail*/ SELECT CMS_CATLG_ID /* 상품정보코드 */ ,DECODE(STATUS, 'D', '미사용', '사용') AS STATUS_NM /* 상품상태 */ ,STATUS /* 상품상태(원값) */ ,CMS_CATEG_ID /* 상세분류코드 */ ,(SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS CMS_CATEG_PATH /* 상세분류 전체 경로 */ ,(SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS CMS_CATEG_NAME /* 상세분류명(리프) */ ,(SELECT SG.SG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG CG, KEPSGMG SG WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D' AND CG.SG_ID = SG.SG_ID) AS SG_NAME /* 카테고리(=SG명) */ ,(SELECT CG.SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG CG WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D') AS SG_ID /* 카테고리(=SG코드) */ ,DESCRIPTION_LOC /* 품목명 */ ,MODEL_INFO /* 모델번호 */ ,SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ ,MAKER_NAME /* 제조사 */ ,MAKER_CODE /* 제조사코드 */ ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE_NAME /* 원산지명 */ ,ORIGIN_CODE /* 원산지코드 */ ,ORDER_MEASURE /* 단위 */ ,DECODE(ITEM_GUBUN, 'G', '표준품', '비표준품') AS ITEM_GUBUN_NM /* 상품구분(ICOMCOD1 M118) */ ,ITEM_GUBUN /* 상품구분(원코드) */ ,ONETIME_YN /* 일회성구분(원값 Y/N) */ ,DECODE(NVL(ONETIME_YN,'N'), 'Y', '일회성', '일반') AS ONETIME_NM /* 일회성구분 (Y=일회성 / N·미입력=일반) */ ,TR_HANDLE_TYPE /* TR취급가능여부(원코드 - 셀렉트 selected 판정용) */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M181' AND MD.CODE = CMSCATLG.TR_HANDLE_TYPE) AS TR_HANDLE_NM /* TR취급가능여부(명칭) */ /* 담당자 = 카테고리(SG) 담당 SM. 목록과 같은 정담당(CMSM 1순위) 기준. */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT4 FROM CMSCATEG CG, ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D' AND MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND MD.CODE2 = '1' AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = CG.SG_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME /* 담당자(정담당 SM 이름) */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM CMSCATEG CG, ICOMCOD3 MD WHERE CG.CMS_CATEG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CG.STATUS <> 'D' AND MD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND MD.TYPE = 'CMSM' AND MD.CODE2 = '1' AND MD.FLAG = 'Y' AND MD.CODE1 = CG.SG_ID) AS KEP_USER_NO /* 담당자 USER_ID */ ,NVL(TRIM(MSDS_NO), TRIM(AC_NO)) AS CHEM_INFO_NO /* 화학물질정보 No.(MSDS 우선, 없으면 AC) */ ,(SELECT A.CMC_HARMFUL_YN FROM KEPMSDSHD A WHERE A.MSDS_NO = CMSCATLG.MSDS_NO) AS HARMFUL_YN /* 유해화학물질 */ ,DECODE(SAFE_STATUS, 'CERT', '인증', 'UNCERT', '미인증', 'EXCL', '비대상', '') AS SAFE_STATUS_NM /* 안전인증여부 : 공란(NONE·NULL)/인증/미인증/비대상 */ ,SAFE_STATUS /* 안전인증여부(원코드) */ ,DECODE(SAFE_TYPE, 'KC', 'KC인증', 'KCS', 'KCS인증', 'KFI', 'KFI인증', SAFE_TYPE) AS SAFE_TYPE_NM /* 안전인증구분(상세분류에 따라 자동 지정) */ ,SAFE_TYPE /* 안전인증구분(원코드) */ ,SAFE_NO /* 안전인증번호 */ ,IMGFILE_DIR /* 상품이미지 S3 경로 */ ,IMGFILE_NAME /* 상품이미지 파일명 */ ,NVL2(TRIM(IMGFILE_DIR), 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||IMGFILE_DIR||'/'||IMGFILE_NAME, '') AS ITEM_IMAGE /* 상품이미지 URL (미등록이면 공백) */ ,DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR /* 상세이미지 S3 경로 */ ,DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME /* 상세이미지 파일명 */ ,NVL2(TRIM(DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR), 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||DETAIL_IMGFILE_DIR||'/'||DETAIL_IMGFILE_NAME, '') AS DETAIL_ITEM_IMAGE /* 상세이미지 URL (미등록이면 공백) */ ,ADD_DATE /* 최초등록일 */ ,CHANGE_DATE /* 최종변경일 */ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = CMSCATLG.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME /* 등록담당자 */ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = CMSCATLG.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NAME /* 변경담당자 */ ,QUOTATION_NO /* 등록견적번호(Key) 예: RE26xxxxxxxx */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(BASE_PRICE)) AS BASE_PRICE /* 기준가(원값 - 화면에서 콤마 포맷) */ ,BASE_PRICE_TYPE /* 기준가유형(원코드 - 셀렉트 selected 판정용) */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M183' AND MD.CODE = CMSCATLG.BASE_PRICE_TYPE) AS BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM /* 기준가유형(명칭) */ ,NVL((SELECT 'Y' FROM CMSCATLG_HST H WHERE H.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMSCATLG.CMS_CATLG_ID AND H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' AND ROWNUM = 1), 'N') AS BASE_PRICE_CHG_YN /* 기준가 변경여부 : BASE_PRICE 이력이 1건이라도 있으면 Y */ FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_msds_no} -- AND STD_FLAG = 'M' /* 상품정보 조회 및 관리 */

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemHistoryList*/ SELECT CASE WHEN V.SORT_SEQ = 0 THEN '최초등록' WHEN V.JOB_DATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,1,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,7,2) || CASE WHEN V.ADD_TIME IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(V.ADD_TIME)) < 6 THEN '' ELSE ' '||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,3,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,5,2) END END AS CHANGE_DATE /* 변경일자 : 첫 줄은 날짜 대신 '최초등록' */ ,CASE WHEN V.STATUS_V IS NULL THEN '' ELSE DECODE(V.STATUS_V, 'D', '미사용', '사용') END AS CMS_STATUS /* 상품상태 */ ,V.DESCRIPTION_V AS DESCRIPTION_LOC /* 품목명 */ ,V.MODEL_V AS MODEL_INFO /* 모델번호 */ ,V.SPEC_V AS SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = V.MAKER_V) AS MAKER_NAME /* 제조사 : 코드만 추적, 표시는 M104 */ ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = V.ORIGIN_V) AS ORIGIN_CODE_NAME /* 원산지 */ ,V.MEASURE_V AS ORDER_MEASURE /* 단위 */ ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M181' AND CODE = V.TR_V) AS TR_HANDLE_NM /* TR취급가능여부 */ ,CASE WHEN V.GUBUN_V IS NULL THEN '' ELSE DECODE(V.GUBUN_V, 'G', '표준품', '비표준품') END AS ITEM_GUBUN_NM /* 상품구분 */ ,(SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = V.CATEG_V AND STATUS <> 'D') AS CMS_CATEG_NAME /* 상세분류 */ ,NVL((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M182' AND CODE = V.CHANGE_REASON_CODE) , V.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK) AS CHANGE_REASON /* 변경사유 : 상품상태는 코드(M182), 그 외는 텍스트 */ ,V.ALT_CATLG_ID AS ALT_CATLG_ID /* 대체코드 */ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = V.ADD_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER /* 변경담당자 */ FROM ( SELECT 0 AS SORT_SEQ, C.ADD_DATE AS JOB_DATE, '000000' AS ADD_TIME, 0 AS JOB_SEQ , CASE WHEN F.STATUS_H = 'Y' THEN F.STATUS_O ELSE C.STATUS END AS STATUS_V , CASE WHEN F.DESCRIPTION_H = 'Y' THEN F.DESCRIPTION_O ELSE C.DESCRIPTION_LOC END AS DESCRIPTION_V , CASE WHEN F.MODEL_H = 'Y' THEN F.MODEL_O ELSE C.MODEL_INFO END AS MODEL_V , CASE WHEN F.SPEC_H = 'Y' THEN F.SPEC_O ELSE C.SPECIFICATION END AS SPEC_V , CASE WHEN F.MAKER_H = 'Y' THEN F.MAKER_O ELSE C.MAKER_CODE END AS MAKER_V , CASE WHEN F.ORIGIN_H = 'Y' THEN F.ORIGIN_O ELSE C.ORIGIN_CODE END AS ORIGIN_V , CASE WHEN F.MEASURE_H = 'Y' THEN F.MEASURE_O ELSE C.ORDER_MEASURE END AS MEASURE_V , CASE WHEN F.TR_H = 'Y' THEN F.TR_O ELSE C.TR_HANDLE_TYPE END AS TR_V , CASE WHEN F.GUBUN_H = 'Y' THEN F.GUBUN_O ELSE C.ITEM_GUBUN END AS GUBUN_V , CASE WHEN F.CATEG_H = 'Y' THEN F.CATEG_O ELSE C.CMS_CATEG_ID END AS CATEG_V , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS CHANGE_REASON_REMARK , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS ALT_CATLG_ID , C.ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSCATLG C , (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'STATUS' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS STATUS_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'STATUS' THEN 'Y' END) AS STATUS_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'DESCRIPTION_LOC' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS DESCRIPTION_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'DESCRIPTION_LOC' THEN 'Y' END) AS DESCRIPTION_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'MODEL_INFO' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS MODEL_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'MODEL_INFO' THEN 'Y' END) AS MODEL_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'SPECIFICATION' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS SPEC_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'SPECIFICATION' THEN 'Y' END) AS SPEC_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'MAKER_CODE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS MAKER_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'MAKER_CODE' THEN 'Y' END) AS MAKER_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ORIGIN_CODE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS ORIGIN_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ORIGIN_CODE' THEN 'Y' END) AS ORIGIN_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ORDER_MEASURE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS MEASURE_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ORDER_MEASURE' THEN 'Y' END) AS MEASURE_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS TR_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE' THEN 'Y' END) AS TR_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ITEM_GUBUN' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS GUBUN_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'ITEM_GUBUN' THEN 'Y' END) AS GUBUN_H , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'CMS_CATEG_ID' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS CATEG_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'CMS_CATEG_ID' THEN 'Y' END) AS CATEG_H FROM (SELECT JOB_COLUMN , MIN(OLD_DATA) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY JOB_DATE, ADD_TIME, JOB_SEQ) AS FIRST_OLD FROM CMSCATLG_HST WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} GROUP BY JOB_COLUMN)) F WHERE C.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS SORT_SEQ, H.JOB_DATE, H.ADD_TIME, H.JOB_SEQ , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'STATUS' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'DESCRIPTION_LOC' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'MODEL_INFO' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'SPECIFICATION' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'MAKER_CODE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'ORIGIN_CODE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'ORDER_MEASURE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'ITEM_GUBUN' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , CASE WHEN H.JOB_COLUMN = 'CMS_CATEG_ID' THEN H.NEW_DATA END , H.CHANGE_REASON_CODE , H.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK , H.ALT_CATLG_ID , H.ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSCATLG_HST H WHERE H.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} AND H.JOB_COLUMN <> 'BASE_PRICE' ) V ORDER BY V.SORT_SEQ, V.JOB_DATE, V.ADD_TIME, V.JOB_SEQ

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemBasePriceHistoryList*/ SELECT CASE WHEN V.SORT_SEQ = 0 THEN '최초등록' WHEN V.JOB_DATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,1,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(V.JOB_DATE,7,2) || CASE WHEN V.ADD_TIME IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(V.ADD_TIME)) < 6 THEN '' ELSE ' '||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,3,2)||':'||SUBSTR(V.ADD_TIME,5,2) END END AS CHANGE_DATE /* 변경일자 : 첫 줄은 날짜 대신 '최초등록' */ ,CASE WHEN V.BASE_PRICE IS NULL OR TRIM(V.BASE_PRICE) IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(V.BASE_PRICE), 'FM999,999,999,990')) END AS BASE_PRICE /* 기준가 */ ,V.BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM AS BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM /* 기준가유형 */ ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M184' AND CODE = V.CHANGE_REASON_CODE) AS CHANGE_REASON /* 변경사유 (M184 미채번 - 적재 전까지 공백) */ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = V.ADD_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER /* 변경담당자 */ FROM ( SELECT 0 AS SORT_SEQ, C.ADD_DATE AS JOB_DATE, '000000' AS ADD_TIME, 0 AS JOB_SEQ , CASE WHEN F.PRICE_H = 'Y' THEN F.PRICE_O ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(C.BASE_PRICE)) END AS BASE_PRICE /* 최초등록 시점의 유형은 HST 에 남지 않는다(REMARK 는 '변경 후' 값이라서). 이력이 한 건도 없을 때만 현재값이 곧 최초값이므로 그때만 채우고, 아니면 공백. */ , CASE WHEN F.PRICE_H = 'Y' THEN '' ELSE (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND CODE = C.BASE_PRICE_TYPE) END AS BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE , C.ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSCATLG C , (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' THEN FIRST_OLD END) AS PRICE_O , MAX(CASE WHEN JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' THEN 'Y' END) AS PRICE_H FROM (SELECT JOB_COLUMN , MIN(OLD_DATA) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY JOB_DATE, ADD_TIME, JOB_SEQ) AS FIRST_OLD FROM CMSCATLG_HST WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} AND JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' GROUP BY JOB_COLUMN)) F WHERE C.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS SORT_SEQ, H.JOB_DATE, H.ADD_TIME, H.JOB_SEQ , H.NEW_DATA , H.CHANGE_REASON_REMARK , H.CHANGE_REASON_CODE , H.ADD_USER_ID FROM CMSCATLG_HST H WHERE H.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id} AND H.JOB_COLUMN = 'BASE_PRICE' ) V ORDER BY V.SORT_SEQ, V.JOB_DATE, V.ADD_TIME, V.JOB_SEQ

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemDetailBuyInfoList*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID /* 구매정보코드 (키) */ ,LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_SEQ /* 구매정보코드 : 화면 표기는 순번만 쓴다(상품정보코드는 옆 열에 있다) */ ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT) AS VENDOR_NAME /* 협력사명 */ /* TO_CHAR 필수 : 이 팝업은 스크립틀릿이라 Map 값을 String 으로 캐스팅한다. NUMBER 를 그대로 내리면 BigDecimal 이 담겨 ClassCastException 이 난다(값이 NULL 인 동안은 통과한다). */ ,RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P.BUY_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990.99999'), '.') AS UNIT_PRICE /* 매입단가 */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.MIN_ORDER_QTY)) AS MOQ /* 최소주문수량 */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.PUR_UNIT_QTY)) AS ORDER_MULTIPLE /* 주문배수수량 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M034' AND MD.CODE = P.PROCESS_TYPE) AS TRADE_TYPE /* 거래유형 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M186' AND MD.CODE = P.DELIVERY_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_TYPE /* 배송유형 */ /* 입고TR : 저장은 센터 회사코드다. 화면엔 센터명으로 보여야 하므로 W001(TEXT1=코드 / TEXT2=명 / TEXT4=B 구매사측)에서 되찾는다. 목록에 없는 코드는 코드 그대로 남긴다 - 빈칸이면 값이 있는지조차 안 보인다. */ ,NVL((SELECT MAX(MD.TEXT2) FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'W001' AND MD.TEXT4 = 'B' AND MD.TEXT1 = P.WAREHOUSE_CODE) , P.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS IN_TR /* 입고TR(센터명) */ ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.DELIVERY_LT)) AS LEADTIME /* 배송일수 */ ,P.BUY_OPEN_DATE AS VALID_FROM /* 유효기간 시작일 */ ,P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE AS VALID_TO /* 유효기간 종료일 */ FROM CMSPRICE P WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_msds_no} ORDER BY P.CATLG_SEQ

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsItemBasePriceInfo*/ SELECT CMS_CATLG_ID ,DESCRIPTION_LOC ,MODEL_INFO ,SPECIFICATION ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = CMSCATLG.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME ,ORDER_MEASURE ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(BASE_PRICE)) AS BASE_PRICE ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(BASE_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990')) AS BASE_PRICE_VIEW ,BASE_PRICE_TYPE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND CODE = CMSCATLG.BASE_PRICE_TYPE) AS BASE_PRICE_TYPE_NM FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_catlg_id}
mapper.update: /*updateMasterMdCmCmsItemBasePriceApplyBulk*/ UPDATE CMSCATLG SET BASE_PRICE = TO_NUMBER(F_HST_CMSCATLG(CMS_CATLG_ID , 'BASE_PRICE' , NVL(#{PRICE_AFTER}, TRIM(TO_CHAR(BASE_PRICE))) , #{st_user_id} , (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M184' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{CHG_REASON}) , NVL(#{PRICE_TYPE_AFTER} , (SELECT MIN(TEXT1) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND CODE = CMSCATLG.BASE_PRICE_TYPE)) , NULL)) , BASE_PRICE_TYPE = NVL((SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{PRICE_TYPE_AFTER}) , BASE_PRICE_TYPE) , CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{CMS_CATLG_ID} AND (#{PRICE_AFTER} IS NULL OR BASE_PRICE IS NULL OR TO_NUMBER(#{PRICE_AFTER}) >= BASE_PRICE)

/*insertMasterMdCmCmsItemBasePriceReqDtBulk*/ INSERT INTO KEPMGPDT ( BUYER, PM_NO, PM_SEQ, STATUS, REG_DATE, CHANGE_DATE, REG_USER_ID , CMS_CATLG_ID , RE_BASE_PRICE, CH_BASE_PRICE , RE_BASE_PRICE_TYPE, CH_BASE_PRICE_TYPE , BASE_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON ) SELECT #{st_com_code}, #{st_pm_no}, #{st_pm_seq}, 'C', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id} , C.CMS_CATLG_ID , C.BASE_PRICE, TO_NUMBER(#{PRICE_AFTER}) , C.BASE_PRICE_TYPE , NVL((SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M183' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{PRICE_TYPE_AFTER}) , C.BASE_PRICE_TYPE) , (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M184' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{CHG_REASON}) FROM CMSCATLG C WHERE C.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{CMS_CATLG_ID}
